subject: Re: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request
thread_body:
From: Rachel Evans <rachel.evans@summitinsurance.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vendor Risk <vendor.risk@summitinsurance.com>, Tom Willis <tom.willis@summitinsurance.com>
Date: Sat, Dec 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM -0800
Subject: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Priyom,

We’re moving into our vendor risk review for Redwood (inference platform). Two asks:

1) Security questionnaire turnaround: Attached is our standard questionnaire (v3). What’s your expected turnaround time? We’re aiming to complete our risk package by 12/22.

2) Evidence: We’ll need your SOC 2 Type II report and any supporting artifacts you typically provide (IR plan overview, vuln mgmt summary, etc.). What’s the process for requesting those?

Optional but helpful: can we schedule a 30–45 min call next week with your security contact to walk through the higher-risk sections (data retention, audit logging, access controls)?

Thanks,
Rachel Evans
Vendor Risk Manager
Summit Insurance

Attachment: Summit_Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx


---
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Evans <rachel.evans@summitinsurance.com>
Cc: Tom Willis <tom.willis@summitinsurance.com>, Vendor Risk <vendor.risk@summitinsurance.com>
Date: Sat, Dec 13, 2025 at 10:03 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Rachel — thanks for sending.

1) Turnaround time
If you can confirm which deployment mode you’re evaluating (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC), we can tailor a few sections. For the questionnaire itself, we typically turn around within ~5 business days once we have the final doc + any required context (e.g., region requirements, retention expectations).

Given your 12/22 target, we should be OK if we lock scope early next week.

2) SOC 2 / evidence request process
We can share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. The standard flow is:
- Summit sends/executes NDA (or we can provide ours)
- You email the request + artifact list
- We provide the SOC 2 report and our standard evidence packet (as applicable)

If it’s helpful, I can also send our customer-facing security FAQ now (it answers a lot of the “how do you handle customer data / training / retention” questions).

3) Security review call
Yes — I can set up a 45-min security review call next week. How’s Tue 12/16 10:15–11:00am PT or Wed 12/17 1:00–1:45pm PT?

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Willis <tom.willis@summitinsurance.com>

Priyom,

We’re evaluating Dedicated first, with a potential path to Private/VPC later (regulatory team is still deciding). US region preferred.

On evidence — we can do NDA quickly (we have our standard NDA; if you prefer yours, send it).

On the call: Tue 12/16 at 10:15am PT works.

Also, can you confirm:
- Whether you train/fine-tune models on customer prompts/outputs
- Typical retention for logs vs customer content (we’re sensitive to this)
- Whether audit logs can be exported to our SIEM

Thanks,
Tom
Security Architect, Summit Insurance


---
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Willis <tom.willis@summitinsurance.com>
Cc: Rachel Evans <rachel.evans@summitinsurance.com>, Vendor Risk <vendor.risk@summitinsurance.com>
Date: Sat, Dec 13, 2025 at 11:02 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request

Tom — perfect, thanks.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 12/16 10:15–11:00am PT. We’ll have our Product Security PM (Naomi Feldman) join to cover the access controls / logging / retention questions.

Quick answers in the meantime (and Naomi can go deeper on the call):
- Model training: Redwood does not train or fine-tune our served models on customer prompts/outputs.
- Retention: retention varies by deployment mode and whether logging is enabled; we can walk through defaults vs configurable options on the call.
- Audit logs: audit logs are available and export options depend on deployment; we’ll confirm what’s supported for Dedicated in your target setup.

Re: NDA + SOC 2 report — please send your standard NDA when ready and we’ll route for signature. Once executed, we’ll share the SOC 2 report + the usual supporting docs we provide.

I’m attaching our current customer-facing Security FAQ as well (covers the common data use/training definitions and a summary of auth/RBAC/audit logging).

Best,
Priyom

Attachment: Redwood_Security_FAQ_(Customer)_2025-11.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Evans <rachel.evans@summitinsurance.com>, Tom Willis <tom.willis@summitinsurance.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Vendor Risk <vendor.risk@summitinsurance.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 15, 2025 at 9:18 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Rachel, hi Tom — Naomi here (Product Security PM).

Ahead of tomorrow’s call, a couple clarifications that may help you fill out the questionnaire:

- Customer data & training
Redwood does not use customer prompts/inputs/outputs to train or fine-tune models.

- Dedicated deployment (high level)
Dedicated provides data isolation at the infrastructure level (dedicated GPU pools) and supports SSO/RBAC and audit logging in the Redwood Console. For evidence details, we’ll provide the SOC 2 report under NDA.

- Evidence requests
Once NDA is in place, we can share:
  - SOC 2 Type II report
  - Standard security overview / control summary
  - Additional artifacts where appropriate (e.g., incident response overview, vulnerability management summary)

If there are specific controls you know will be “red flags” for Summit (e.g., log retention limits, audit log fields, SIEM export destinations), feel free to reply with the exact questionnaire items and we’ll prep precise language for the call.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Product Security, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Summit Insurance — security questionnaire turnaround + SOC 2 evidence request

Naomi — thank you.

We’ll send our standard NDA today (separate email) and will include request for:
- SOC 2 Type II report
- Subprocessor list (current)
- Confirmation of incident notification window (high-level is fine)

For the call tomorrow, the “red flag” sections are:
- Data retention for prompts/outputs (if any) vs operational logs
- Audit log export to SIEM (we prefer S3 or equivalent)
- SSO/SAML requirements (Okta)

See you tomorrow.

Rachel
